imgDesc.text:
In certain places in Snezhnaya, a Starlight Prism will also generate a Prism Mirage that lasts for a short time at the same location when it vanishes.
Approach the mirage to activate the Starlight Prism again, at which point it will remain on the field permanently.
Prisms activated by such interactions have a chance to appear in other Travelers' worlds. Similarly, Prisms from other Travelers' worlds may also appear in your world.

In certain places in Snezhnaya, the Polestar Field also presents with additional capabilities:
· When inside a Polestar Field, the Eye of Graeae will not lose any energy. If the Eye's energy level is below 30%, it will also be immediately restored to 30%.
· It also appears that Prime Ice Constructs inside a Polestar Field will gain various wondrous buffs...
